description: Dispatcher for a single page block — renders the correct markup per BlockType, manages contenteditable lifecycle via JS interop, and surfaces block events to the parent.

parameters.name: BlockHasUnreadActivity
parameters.description: True when any thread on this block has unread activity (new entry, reaction, resolve).

parameters.name: BlockLastAuthorName
parameters.description: Total number of comment threads on this block.

parameters.name: BlockResolvedUnreadCount
parameters.description: Number of resolved-but-unread block comment threads for this block.

parameters.name: BlockThreadCount
parameters.description: Total number of comment threads on this block.

parameters.name: BlockUnresolvedCount
parameters.description: Number of unresolved block comment threads for this block.

parameters.name: NumberedListNumber
parameters.description: 1-based ordinal for NumberedList blocks, pre-computed by TmNotionBlockList.

parameters.name: PreviousListIndentLevel
parameters.description: Indent level of the list item directly above this block, or null when this is the first block or the block above is not a list item. Tab may not nest deeper than one level below it.

parameters.name: OnMergeWithPrevious
parameters.description: Raised when Backspace at the start of this block should fold it into its predecessor. The payload is the block's current HTML.

parameters.name: OnComment
parameters.description: Raised when the user clicks the Comment button in the block handle menu.

parameters.name: OnFocused
parameters.description: 1-based ordinal for NumberedList blocks, pre-computed by TmNotionBlockList.

parameters.name: OnInsertTemplateBlocks
parameters.description: Raised when a TemplateButton block requests insertion of its template blocks after itself.

parameters.name: OnMentionMenu
parameters.type: EventCallback<(string BlockId, double Top, double Left)>
parameters.description: Raised when '@' mention syntax is typed. Args are viewport coords.

parameters.name: OnMoveFocus
parameters.description: Raised when a text block requests keyboard focus movement to a sibling block.

parameters.name: OnNewThread
parameters.description: Raised when the user clicks the New Thread button in the block handle menu.

parameters.name: OnPageLinkMenu
parameters.type: EventCallback<(string BlockId, double Top, double Left)>
parameters.description: Raised when '[[' page-link syntax is typed. Args are viewport coords.

parameters.name: OnSlashMenu
parameters.type: EventCallback<(string BlockId, double Top, double Left)>
parameters.description: Raised when a '/' typed in this block opens the slash menu. Args are viewport coords.

parameters.name: OnTokenMenu
parameters.type: EventCallback<(string BlockId, double Top, double Left)>
parameters.description: Raised when '{{' token syntax is typed. Args are viewport coords.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Parent block ID for nested lists. Null means the top-level page list.
